sources.title: Tiny robot duck can walk, grab objects and learn new tricks
sources.snippet: MicroDuck is a compact biped designed for experimenting with physical AI and robot movement. Images courtesy of Hugging Face/Pollen Robotics Most small consumer robots are designed to sit on a desk, answer questions or act as animated companions. Pollen Robotics' new MicroDuck takes a more physical approach.

sources.title: Microduck - A tiny biped robot you can teach new tricks | Pollen Robotics
sources.snippet: Microduck is a 25 cm biped robot with 15 motors, a camera, LiDAR and a grasping beak. Playable out of the box, and its open-source stack lets you train new behaviours in simulation and run them on the robot. Pre-order at $399.
